description: Read-only React project review with specialized code quality, testing strategy, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility skills plus MCP audit tools.

defaultPrompt: Review this React project and prioritize actionable findings.
Audit my React tests and identify coverage gaps.
Audit this React UI for WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility risks.
interface.longDescription: A read-only React project review plugin. It combines three modular skills for architecture and code quality, testing strategy, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility with MCP tools for project inventory, source-file inspection, test-setup inventory, and heuristic accessibility checks. Static findings are explicitly labeled as heuristic; tests, coverage, browser behavior, and WCAG conformance are never claimed unless independently verified.

name: react-review-ai
